title: a page taken beside a file of its name
line: collect never writes a saved page over a file of the same name already in the inbox: the page takes a free name beside it, its result naming the name it was saved under and the one it has in the inbox, and the file that was there stays as it was

steps.say: her Kentucky death records search saved from the fetch list into the download folder
another search's page already in the inbox under that very name
collect: the saved page comes into the inbox beside the file of its name and reaches her step

has: (2).html, beside a file of the name it was saved under

expect.why: the page keeps its own identity and reaches its step; the name it had to take is on the line the tool prints
the file that was in the inbox under that name is there still, its own bytes, not written over
the saved page left the download folder
